sentences.text: In these circumstances, applicants be released on bail.

4. Heard the counsel for the parties.
5.
Considering facts and circumstances of the case, bail application filed by applicants is allowed.

6. It is directed that applicants be released on bail on their furnishing personal bond in sum of Rs.50,000/-(Rs.
